description: This file declares external functions related to the Slap Object Wrapper in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) for the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, initializing, and resetting Slap OWO objects.

methods.name: SlapCreateObjWrapper
methods.description: Creates an object wrapper handle with provided container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: SlapOwoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Slap Object Wrapper.

methods.name: SlapOwoRemove
methods.description: Removes a given Slap OWO object.

methods.name: SlapOwoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects for the given Slap OWO instance.

methods.name: SlapOwoReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the Slap OWO object.
